categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three business segments: Integrated Logistics (IL), E-commerce & Express (E&E), and International Freight Forwarding (IFF). IL includes storage, inventory, trucking, distribution, and value-added services mainly in Asia. E&E focuses on e-commerce logistics and domestic parcel delivery services. IFF provides freight forwarding services across Asia, Europe, and the Americas using air, ocean, and cross-border road freight.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages multimodal logistics solutions integrating air, ocean, and road freight forwarding. It employs advanced supply chain digitalization, machine learning, and artificial intelligence for cybersecurity and operational efficiency. The company also uses electric trucks in Hong Kong and emphasizes green logistics solutions to minimize environmental impact.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves over 40 of the Top 100 global brands across diverse industries including fashion, electronics, food and beverage, fast-moving consumer goods, industrial materials, automotive, pharmaceutical, and healthcare. Its customers range from manufacturers and retailers to e-commerce businesses requiring sophisticated, regional, and critical supply chain solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a strong presence in Asia, including Hong Kong, Mainland China, Taiwan, Southeast Asia, and South Asia. It also operates in the Americas (notably the United States), Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA), and Oceania (Australia and New Zealand). Its logistics network includes over 59 countries and territories worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a third-party logistics (3PL) provider, positioned midstream in the supply chain. It offers integrated logistics, freight forwarding, and express delivery services but does not own or operate aircraft or vessels. It manages warehousing, transportation, and distribution services, acting as a critical logistics partner for its customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding air freight capacity, last-mile delivery, and cross-border express networks, especially in Asia, through integration with S.F. Holding. The company focuses on supply chain digitalization, sustainability with a net zero emissions goal by 2050, and innovation in multimodal logistics solutions. It actively pursues new market opportunities and emerging trade lanes, targeting verticals like pharmaceutical and medical logistics.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through service fees from integrated logistics, e-commerce and express delivery, and international freight forwarding. The company also earns rental income from investment properties and ancillary services such as warehouse management and value-added logistics solutions. Revenue recognition is primarily over time for logistics services and at a point in time for sales of goods.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading logistics service provider in Asia with a unique market position and unrivalled network in the region. It is ranked among the top global 3PLs and freight forwarders by industry analysts. Its integration with S.F. Holding enhances its competitive edge. Major competitors include other global and regional logistics and freight forwarding companies, but the company emphasizes its diversified global solutions and strong Asian presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, the company reported revenue of HK$86.6 billion, a 10% increase year-on-year, and core net profit of HK$3.57 billion, up 11%. It operates over 6,700 self-owned vehicles and manages 66 million square feet of land and facilities with more than 43,000 employees worldwide. The company has shown resilience amid market volatility and continues to grow through acquisitions and organic expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers customers diversified, integrated logistics solutions with a strong focus on Asia, leveraging its extensive network and cross-selling synergies with S.F. Holding. It emphasizes sustainability, innovation, and customized multimodal logistics services to meet complex supply chain needs. Its commitment to operational excellence, customer service, and digital transformation differentiates it in a competitive global logistics market.
